findings.description: SWR-DIA-001 requires each applicable fault report within 10 ms. The interface permits later reports in a burst to miss that deadline, and OP-SWC-009 defers the burst limit to verification without establishing the required guarantee.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the report deadline for every permitted fault burst at architecture or requirements level; do not defer the missing guarantee to verification.

findings.description: SWR-TIM-001 and SWR-TIM-002 require detection no later than 100 µs after the configured limit expires. The compare is armed at the limit plus 100 µs, with another 100 µs allowed for entry and decision, permitting detection 200 µs after the configured limit.
findings.requested_change: Specify a detection mechanism and latency bound that satisfy both the deadline and the equality rules.

findings.description: SWR-LAT-012 counts a code 8 report when it is made, and SWR-LAT-004 latches on the third counted detection. The component increments the retained code 8 count even when transmission is interrupted and no report is made; a later completed report can therefore latch after fewer than three reports.
findings.requested_change: Update the code 8 count and latch at the report event consistently with SWR-LAT-004 and SWR-LAT-012, including interrupted transmissions.

findings.description: The start-up task queues the code 8 report and services transmission between CRC chunks, but does not require report completion before checking the latch and permitting normal start-up. Checks could finish before the third code 8 report completes and sets the latch.
findings.requested_change: Specify the sequencing that prevents task release and status-high while the pending code 8 report could set the latch.

findings.description: SWR-RES-001 limits normal-operation supervisor execution to 10% over any 1 s window. OP-SWC-001 defers task and interrupt execution budgets and the core clock, so the stated 500 µs CRC allowance plus the other execution contexts cannot be shown to fit that limit or the diagnostic and detection deadlines.
findings.requested_change: Allocate and justify compatible execution budgets and scheduling bounds at architecture level, or record the missing architecture-level decisions as blocking open points.

findings.description: The tenth-cycle flow check can find T_DIAG missing even while it is within its configured 20 ms execution limit. OP-SWC-011 identifies the unresolved interaction with the 10 ms cycle and asks whether the checkpoint is judged in the release cycle or later.
findings.requested_change: Resolve the flow-check and T_DIAG timing interaction against the controlling requirements and specify the resulting sequence.
